label: Compact remnants
description: A separately loaded, source-defined overlay of catalogued pulsars, their measured neutron-star companions and curated dormant compact-object systems within 3000 light-years.
cutoffPolicy: ATNF v2.9.0 non-candidate, non-interim pulsars with positive adopted DIST <= 0.9198041814 kpc, their reviewed neutron-star companions with measured masses, plus reviewed dormant black-hole and non-pulsar neutron-star systems no farther than 3000 light-years. Candidate status is explicit.
